I would say so-so because of CSS rules like `.ais-menu--item__active .facet-value, .facet-value:hover, .ais-refinement-list--item__active .ais-refinement-list--label, .ais-hierarchical-menu--item__active > div > .facet-value {...}` => very hard to "share" behavior because of BEM. Let's see when building new the Amazon-like theme :) (cc @kokliKo)

@redox: At first I thought we could add more generic classes to all elements that inherit from refinementList. 

But `.ais-hierarchical-menu--item__active > div > .facet-value` is very weird. I'm surprise you had to resort to such a selector.

> I'm surprised you had to resort to such a selector.

I've updated the PR and it's not optimal yet. The behavior I want to implement is making bold the labels of every single facet (be it menu, refinement list or toggle) when you hover or refine them. All of that without custom template obviously :)
But you don't need `> div >` for that. The divs are just React `noise`, this should not be reflected in the selectors.

> But you don't need > div > for that. The divs are just React noise, this should not be reflected in the selectors.

I need the div because I want to highlight the first child `<label>` only.

> I need the div because I want to highlight the first child <label> only.

Might be an issue if we need this kind of workaround. The fact that we use React should stay internal and not pop up to the stylesheets.
